reuse.why: Uses the shared getFillableCategories selection, getSheetValue, setBudget, batchMessages and the mutator/undoable registration, but re-inlines the income-skip guard and sign flip rather than sharing them.

duplication.why: The `is_income === 1 && !isTrackingBudget()` skip and the expense sign flip are copied once more from the sibling month-wide actions (set3MonthAvg, setZero) instead of being factored out.

placement.why: Action lives in server/budget/actions.ts next to the other month-wide actions and is registered in app.ts beside them.

scope.why: Only the new action and its handler type/registration are added.

maintainability.why: Small, idiomatic and consistent with its siblings; the repeated per-action income/sign logic is a minor maintenance cost.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Category selection goes through getFillableCategories; no existing abstraction is bypassed.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied income guard and sign flip are verbatim copies of the sibling pattern, not disguised.
